title: Head and Torso
seoDescription: GRAS KEMAR head and torso simulators for hearing aid, headset, headphone, telephone, sound quality and automotive acoustic testing, including AutoKEMAR 45BD.

props.title: Head and Torso
paragraphs: Audio design is a vital part of developing cars, computers, hearing aids, mobile phones and many other products. The GRAS KEMAR head and torso simulator was first developed with the audiological industry for hearing aid work and remains its de facto standard.

KEMAR is built on statistical research of the average human body, so it has the acoustic properties of a real person, and it meets ISO, IEC and ANSI standards. Its use has spread to telecommunications, hearing protection, noise abatement, sound recording and automotive development.

image.alt: Head and Torso

props.title: KEMAR variants
props.intro: Preconfigured versions for specific purposes, with optional accessories to change the configuration. 45BB variants have no mouth simulator, 45BC variants have one.
